goal: Fix #4782: the merge-queue preview hold accepts a successful Post-merge preview rehearsal recorded on any main commit that descends from the migration-adding commit and is contained in the group base; still refuses when none exists.
prohibited_actions: No change to authorization, interlock, lock or production logic.
assumptions: Descendants are found with git rev-list --ancestry-path target..base, so each contains the migration commit.
stop_conditions: Stop before any production, preview, database or repository-setting action.
